notes.title: STEAM DECK SUPPORT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046060/04f4879a6e106c5eba2e7f4e50447796930cf984.png[/img]

- I hasten to inform you that Steam Deck support has been added, UI problems that could occur when playing on Steam Deck have been eliminated.

- In addition to Steam Deck support, I have added support for Steam Cloud saves.

notes.title: Voiceover and Achievements. Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
In this update we have added:
- Girls voiceover that runs at puzzle start, during game play, and after puzzle assembly
- Achievements for perfect completion of puzzles on different difficulty levels, and for completing all levels of a particular girl.

notes.title: Korean localization. Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
We noticed that the game is popular among players from Korea, so we added:
- Korean localization
